title: fix(tempo): recover the receipt after an ExpiringNonceReplay broadcast
quote: Tempo charge settlement turned a mined payment into a fresh 402 when a sync broadcast was rejected with ExpiringNonceReplay. ... Mercator saw this on about 4% of its paid Exa searches (44 of 1,016 in an hour)

title: fix: prevent automatic payments during validation probes
quote: Validation probes used the global payment-aware fetch wrapper, allowing a server to trigger payment even when validation requested skipPayment.

title: fix: bind session manager payments to request origin
quote: Reusing a session manager against another origin could disclose the existing channel and authorize vouchers for an unrelated SSE endpoint.

title: fix: charge request-priced session content before handlers
quote: An SSE-enabled request-priced POST could run its handler before discovering that the channel lacked funds. Repeated rejected requests could therefore perform unpaid work.

title: fix: bound websocket payment close reasons
quote: A rejected payment could leave a WebSocket open when the route's error body exceeded the protocol's 123-byte close-reason limit.

title: fix: accept RFC 9530 byte-sequence digests in BodyDigest.verify
quote: the challenge schema accepts it, but BodyDigest.verify only matched the bare sha-256=<base64> that compute emits, so a correct body failed against a spec-form digest.

title: fix(tempo): apply client spending options to session payments
quote: tempo.session() now accepts and enforces currencies, maxAmount, maxAtomicAmount and expectedRecipients, which tempo() already passes through its shared parameters.

title: fix(evm): return invalid_exact_evm_payload for malformed exact payloads
quote: Callers of the TypeScript exact EVM facilitator should get invalid_exact_evm_payload for a malformed EIP-3009 or Permit2 payload, the same reason Go and Python already return. ... This tracks https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/issues/4050 and does not close it.

title: fix(python): return structured invalid_upto_* errors for malformed upto Permit2 payloads
quote: The Python upto Permit2 facilitator did not return the structured errors the Go implementation returns for malformed payloads ... Go's upto facilitator already does this correctly.

title: fix(evm): return invalid_upto_evm_payload for malformed upto Permit2 payloads (TypeScript)
quote: Port of https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/4060 from Python to TypeScript SDK. The @x402/evm upto facilitator now validates the raw Permit2 payload shape before verify and settle, so malformed payloads return invalid_upto_evm_payload

title: SDK drift detected 2026-10-29
quote: Malformed exact EVM payload reason code — small ... SDKs changed: TypeScript, Drift now in: TypeScript

title: fix(python): isolate facilitator advisory hook errors
quote: Port of https://github.com/x402-foundation/x402/pull/3151 from TypeScript to Python SDK. A throwing after_verify, after_settle, on_verify_failure or on_settle_failure hook ... is now logged at warning level and skipped, so it can no longer change the verify/settle result or reject settle() after the payment executed onchain.

title: SDK drift detected 2026-10-31
quote: Facilitator advisory lifecycle hook error isolation — medium ... Drift now in: Python ... Python x402Facilitator still propagates a throwing advisory hook into the failure path and can reject settle() after a successful onchain settlement.

title: fix(evm): persist sync auth-capture balances for refunds
quote: Sync escrow captures succeed, but TypeScript leaves the stored balances unchanged. Later refunds then fail with a payment-state error. Update capture and cancel accounting from the original client collect payload, matching the Go implementation.
